name: aomega-m3-pretzel-block-basis-rank
description: The u -> 0 rank of the pretzel's six residue families is 4, not 6: the three colliding families share one limit, so they cannot be a holomorphic-block basis and no pairing of them is the index.

parameters.families: Part 12b's validated six (2 unit + 4 parity classes)

verdict: MEASURED, structural: the six residue families have u -> 0 rank 4, not 6. The two unit factors and the even-even parity class — exactly the three whose poles collide into GZ's triple pole — share one limit (1 - 2q + 3q^3 + ...), while GZ's own six blocks are independent (rank 6). So no pairing of the residue families, diagonal or otherwise, can be the sigma_1 sigma_1 index: they are not a block basis. The q^0 failure survives the limit (7/8 against the index's 1), which rules out a zeta-identification artefact. What the index needs at the collision is the eps-EXPANSION of the colliding triple (value, first and second derivatives = GZ's H_0, H_1, H_2); the meridian deformation separates the poles WITHOUT separating the limits, so u is not a regularisation of that expansion. Scope (a) for 'the residue families as a block basis', with the invariant exhibited (a rank drop 6 -> 4). Parts 12b/14 are unaffected: they factorise the INTEGRAL, which is a different object, related to the index only through GGM (19) — which pairs blocks.

assertions.name: G1-the two unit factors and the even-even parity class share ONE u -> 0 limit (the three whose poles collide into GZ's triple pole)
G2-the other three limits are pairwise distinct, and distinct from the collided one
G3-the u -> 0 rank of the six families is 4, not 6 — they cannot be a basis of the six-dimensional block space GZ's weight decomposition (1 + 4 + 1) requires
G4-the Part 12b bilinear's q^0 tends to 7/8 as u -> 0, against the index's 1 — the failure survives the limit, so it is not an artefact of the zeta identification
G5-GZ's six q-side blocks H_0..H_5 ARE independent (rank 6) once enough orders are carried, so the shortfall is in our basis, not the target
